remarks: Move-in ready 3-bedroom townhouse in sought-after Sunrise Hill! This well-designed home offers exceptional living space across three thoughtfully planned levels. The main level welcomes you with a bright living room, convenient powder room and eat-in kitchen featuring Corian counters and sliders to the deck-ideal for outdoor entertaining and morning coffee. Upstairs, the primary bedroom impresses with dual walk-in closets, complemented by two generous guest bedrooms and a full bath. The lower level provides laundry convenience, attached private garage access, and versatile bonus space perfect for a playroom, home office or guest retreat. Enjoy amenities including community pool, clubhouse, playground and tennis courts. Energy-efficient gas heat keeps utility costs manageable. Prime location near schools, shopping, and transportation makes daily life effortless.
